skill.summary: Blog writing, social media, SEO, newsletter curation, brand-aware content.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: provides a comprehensive content engine for brand-aware, multi-platform marketing.

- Converts a single brief into 30+ platform-optimized content pieces (blog, social, newsletter)
- Supports brand voice training from custom writing samples
- Delivers SEO-optimized content with platform-specific formatting
- Enables batch processing and multi-topic queues
- Includes frameworks and best practices for content structure, review, and scheduling
